rules.description: Strictly enforce historical deletion average threshold of 0.1%
Ensure zero MCF lint errors in generated output
Verify MaxDate is within allowable 3-year publication lag for all StatVars except rare historical exceptions

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE StatVar NOT IN ('Count_MortalityEvent_ChronicGlomerulonephritisNephritisAndNephritisNotSpecifiedAsAcuteOrChronicAndRenalSclerosisUnspecified', 'Count_MortalityEvent_AccidentalDischargeOfFirearms')
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AND total_svs >= 114
